name: Hunting
notes: Middle TN, multiple spots sharing one weather context: private ground (secured) plus public WMAs. Species: whitetail deer, spring turkey, dove/game birds, coyote (year-round, no closed season), pigs opportunistically -- in TN hogs are private-land-only, year-round, no limit with landowner permission; public land take is essentially closed, so pig sign gets noted during scouting rather than planned. 2026-27 key dates (TWRA, no structural changes from 25-26): quota apps Jun 10-Jul 22, leftovers Aug 19 8AM CDT; dove opens Sep 1; deer archery Sep 26; youth Oct 24-25; muzzleloader Nov 7-20 with straight-wall Nov 14-20 (private land only); gun Nov 21-Jan 3; youth Jan 9-10; spring turkey opens Apr 3 2027 (moved one week earlier this year), youth Mar 27-28; annual licenses expire end of Feb.

activities.name: Submit WMA Quota Hunt Applications
activities.description: DEADLINE: midnight CDT July 22. Apply at gooutdoorstennessee.com or TWRA app -- no mail. Up to 15 hunt choices from ~60 WMA big game hunt options (deer/turkey/bear). Missed draws can still buy leftovers Aug 19.

steps.name: Review WMA hunt options and rank 15 choices

activities.name: Leftover Quota Permits On Sale
activities.description: Undrawn WMA quota permits go first-come first-served at 8:00 AM CDT on gooutdoorstennessee.com, the TWRA app, or license agents. Check draw results first; grab backup hunts.

steps.name: Check quota draw results

activities.name: Summer Scouting & Stand Site Selection
activities.description: Walk the private spots and shortlist public areas: find sign, food, pinch points; pick this year's stand/blind and camera sites. Note pig sign while out -- hogs are shoot-on-sight on private ground here.

steps.name: Map pass on onX/aerials: mark candidate sites and entry routes
Confirm parking, access, and wind-based entry for each site

activities.name: Hang Trail Cameras
activities.description: Cameras onto the sites picked during scouting -- trails, field edges, water. Log each camera location.

steps.name: Fresh batteries, formatted SD cards, mounts packed

activities.name: Kill & Prep Fall Plots
activities.description: Spray existing vegetation on the private-ground plots; lime and fertilize per soil test. Prep now so plots can be planted on a rain in the Sep window.

steps.name: Order plot seed (brassica/cereal grain/clover mix) and fertilizer
Soil test plots if not done this year

activities.name: Plant Fall Food Plots
activities.description: Late Aug to mid-Sep window here -- plant just ahead of a forecast rain. Cultipack or drag for seed contact.

steps.name: Confirm seed and spreader ready; watch forecast for rain
Check germination and browse pressure

activities.name: Gear Prep & Organization
activities.description: Full gear pass before the seasons stack up: clothing and boots inspected, scent-free wash and sealed totes, pack and truck kit organized, knives sharp, drag rope and first aid in the pack.

steps.name: Inventory pass: clothing, boots, calls, ammo, batteries, licenses in wallet/app
Buy replacements for anything worn out or missing

activities.name: Hang Stands & Blinds
activities.description: Sets go up on the sites picked in scouting. Every strap and ratchet inspected -- replace anything questionable, no exceptions on the harness.

steps.name: Inspect straps, ratchets, steps, and safety harness
Trim shooting lanes and clear entry routes

activities.name: Archery Practice Ramp-Up
activities.description: Regular practice from here to the Sep 26 opener, working out to real hunting distances and from elevation.

steps.name: Bow inspection: strings, cams, rest, sight tight
Switch to broadheads and re-verify zero

activities.name: Dove Opener
activities.description: Sep 1, statewide. First segment shooting is the best of the year.

steps.name: Line up a field: private ground or TWRA public dove field list
Pattern shotgun and stock shells

activities.name: Pre-Season Camera Check & Card Pull
activities.description: Card pull one week out from archery so opening-week stand choice runs on current intel, then leave the woods alone.

steps.name: Swap batteries and cards where needed

activities.name: Deer Archery Opener
activities.description: Sep 26. Early-season pattern hunting: evening food sources, unpressured bucks.

steps.name: Pick opening-week stands off camera intel and wind
Confirm tags and regs in TWRA app

activities.name: Rifle & Muzzleloader Zero
activities.description: Range day before the Nov 7 muzzleloader opener and the Nov 14-20 private-land straight-wall week. Zero everything that will see the field.

steps.name: Confirm ammo/powder/primers on hand and book range time

activities.name: Rut Watch
activities.description: Middle TN rut builds through the first three weeks of November -- seeking/chasing peaks around Nov 7-20, which lands in muzzleloader and straight-wall. Best sits of the year; burn vacation days here.

steps.name: Block off hunting days on the calendar

activities.name: Muzzleloader Opener
activities.description: Nov 7-20. Straight-wall cartridge season runs Nov 14-20, private land only, muzzleloader bag limits.

activities.name: Gun Opener
activities.description: Nov 21 through Jan 3. Youth weekends Oct 24-25 and Jan 9-10 bracket the season.

activities.name: Season Wrap: Pull Stands & Cameras
activities.description: After the Jan 9-10 youth weekend closes deer for good: pull sets and cameras, note what worked while it's fresh, walk out fresh late-season sign for next year.

steps.name: Scent-free wash, dry, and seal gear into storage totes

activities.name: Late-Winter Coyote Push
activities.description: Post-deer-season calling window: Jan-Feb breeding season is the best response of the year, and it takes predator pressure off spring fawns and poults. Year-round legal in TN.

steps.name: E-caller charged, hand calls and shooting sticks packed

activities.name: Renew TN Hunting License
activities.description: Annual licenses expire end of February. Renew before turkey scouting starts.

activities.name: Spring Turkey Scouting
activities.description: Three weeks out from the opener: listen at daylight for gobbling, glass field edges, find roosts. Don't bump birds off roosts late in the run-up.

steps.name: Pattern turkey shotgun with hunting loads
Roost birds the weekend before the opener

activities.name: Spring Turkey Opener
activities.description: Apr 3, 2027 -- moved one week earlier this year. Youth weekend Mar 27-28.

steps.name: Confirm turkey tags in TWRA app
Vest check: calls, decoys, mask, gloves

activities.name: 2027 Quota Hunt Applications Open
activities.description: Next cycle's WMA quota application window opens ~June 10, closes ~July 22. This kicks off the 2027-28 season year -- re-plan the domain then.
